notes.title: Oversoul Mission START
notes.content:
[b]The Oversoul's journey begins in one hour![/b] 

Prepare for puzzly destruction, right in your living room on your Macintosh SE (or compatible)!
Blow up corrupted machines like it's 1988. What will you find at depth 49?

[b]Now available at all Babbages & EB Games locations![/b]

Original system requirements:

System 7.1 or higher
2mb of RAM (Virtual Memory ok)
2mb free hard disk space
1.44mb floppy drive required
B&W Monitor capable of 512 × 342 resolution or higher
